notes.title: GAME OFFICIAL RELEASE
notes.notes: On JUNE 14th, 2022, the game is officially released!  There is a 10% discount for the first week only, get a copy now!

notes.title: Bug Fixes June 1st, 2022
notes.notes:
Controller Reconnection Bugfix
-Controller can disconnect and reconnect during character selection screen

Chinese subtitles Bugfix
-Kung-fu girl has subtitles fixed for Simplified Chinese translations

notes.title: June Update 2022
notes.notes:
Added subtitles / conversation texts for 3 additional languages!

French
Spanish
Simplified Chinese


Added a leaderboard (tied to Steam) to track the top scores for each individual level!  The scores doesn't factor in the amount of players per level, so grab your friends to maximize your group's potential!

Created a new website and added a press kit for streamers / youtubers who is interested in trying out my game.

Website: www.mollycoddlemayhem.com

Let me know if you want a language added to the game!  Email me at: mollycoddlemayhem@gmail.com
